payload.title: Cache lowers latency
payload.body: Repeated reads may benefit from a bounded cache. The hypothesis predicts lower median latency under a fixed workload. Memory use must remain within the configured budget. A controlled experiment should compare cold and warm paths.
payload.creator: fixture-generator

payload.title: Large cache failed
payload.body: The oversized cache increased memory pressure in the synthetic trial. Its latency gain disappeared after paging began. This remains an unreviewed candidate until evidence is linked. Future trials should use a smaller bounded cache.
payload.creator: fixture-generator
